title: cFish.io Phase 3 Comprehensive Action Plan

challenges_encountered.description: The script was using incorrect path references for memory files
challenges_encountered.resolution: Implemented proper path resolution using (Get-Location).Path and Join-Path
challenges_encountered.impact: Fixed performance benchmark script to correctly measure all operations

challenges_encountered.description: The parameter block was not at the top of the script, causing execution errors
challenges_encountered.resolution: Moved parameter block to the top of the script before any other code
challenges_encountered.impact: Fixed JSON conversion script to properly accept input and output file parameters

challenges_encountered.description: Performance metrics showed variability between runs
challenges_encountered.resolution: Conducted multiple benchmark runs and used average values
challenges_encountered.impact: Provided more accurate performance improvement metrics
